Analyst teams spend their time collecting and formatting instead of judging, and unmanaged AI output cannot be defended.

Agents work through governed tool interfaces; every AI output waits for a human; each decision records its hypotheses, uncertainty, dissent and the person accountable, and predictions are calibrated against outcomes.

It draws on these skills: [LLM agents](@/skills/llm-agents.md), [Decision support](@/skills/decision-support.md), [Contestable decisions](@/skills/contestable-decisions.md), [AI transformation](@/skills/ai-transformation.md), [Orchestration](@/skills/orchestration.md), [Document extraction](@/skills/document-extraction.md) and [Audit trail](@/skills/audit-trail.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [MCP](@/glossary/mcp.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Ollama](@/glossary/ollama.md) and [Phoenix](@/glossary/phoenix.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md), [Tailwind CSS](@/glossary/tailwind-css.md) and [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md).

12 public repositories show its skills (12 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
